faqTitle: Everything you need to know about Tech Sahaya
faqSubtitle: Clear answers on our DPDP-compliant privacy architecture, family benefit inheritance, and official scheme applications.

faqs.q: How does Tech Sahaya protect my personal privacy under the DPDP Act 2023?
faqs.a: Tech Sahaya strictly complies with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. All documents uploaded for eligibility verification are processed ephemerally in RAM and immediately discarded. No Aadhaar or PAN numbers, biometric records, or raw files are ever stored on disk.

faqs.q: How does Family Benefits matching work if members do not have separate documents?
faqs.a: In Indian households, documents like Ration Cards and Land Records belong to the household file. Tech Sahaya allows family members to inherit the household's verified state, income bracket, and ration credentials, evaluating individual eligibility based on age, gender, and relationship without requiring duplicate documents.

faqs.q: What is the Auto-Filled PDF Application feature?
faqs.a: Once your profile details are verified, Tech Sahaya generates an official Government of India Scheme Application Form pre-filled with your verified credentials. You can download or print the PDF with one click and submit it directly to your nearest CSC center or official scheme portal.

faqs.q: Do I need high-speed internet to use Tech Sahaya?
faqs.a: No. Tech Sahaya is built as a lightweight progressive web application that works seamlessly on 2G/3G connections. Voice interactions are compressed and offline caching allows you to review your verified schemes even without active network coverage.
